dedicated.story:
"...That was the moment Shane approached me. She simply stayed by my side without a word... And from that moment on, we became friends."

Traumatized by being abandoned by her parents as a child, Espada was determined to make sure she was never cast aside ever again. She became a member of the special forces after years of relentless and grueling training. Later, she gained demonic powers while on a mission and was shunned by her comrades, leaving her abandoned once more. Yet, that was when Shane reached out to her — forging a deep and enduring friendship between them.

lore:
Espada is a Crusader who has devoted her life to eradicating demons.
She was trained to fight demons from a young age after she was abandoned by her parents.
She wields a giant sword capable of cleaving through a demon's tough hide, and she also carries experimental weapons such as pistols that fire special anti-demon bullets.
Since she grew up following a highly restrictive and barebones lifestyle, she doesn't talk a lot and employs a dry tone when she does.
She also carries around a general air of grief and gloom after seeing many of her fellow Crusader trainees fall at demons' hands. She's very hesitant to make new friends because she's afraid that she'll just lose them again.
However, she's a very lonely person at heart. She has, therefore, opened up to Shane and Sieg, two dependable comrades who aren't likely to be done in by demons anytime soon.
On one of her past missions, she and a group of other Crusaders were tasked with tracking down and killing a demon that drank the blood of living beings.
Everyone but her was slaughtered by the demon. The last of Espada's comrades made a valiant sacrifice, allowing her to defeat the demon, but in the process she was showered in the demon's cursed blood.
She was miraculously able to avoid the nastier effects of being covered in demon blood and was even able to absorb some of its power.
With newfound strength and a renewed hatred of demons, she continued to hunt demons down as an agent of the Crusaders.
